description: Waterschappen Waterbeheergebieden IMWA is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze dataset is gebaseerd op (niet geharmoniseerde) data van alle waterschappen in Nederland conform het Informatiemodel water (IMWA). De data is gestructureerd volgens het Informatiemodel Water (IMWA), onderdeel van de Aquo-standaard. Meer informatie hierover is te vinden op de Aquo-website. De gegevens worden in Geopackage-formaat geleverd in het RD-New coördinatenstelsel. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are HVD, Hoogwaardige dataset - EU, aanvoerafvoergebied, krwoppervlaktewaterlichaamstilstaand, krwoppervlaktewaterlichaamstromend. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
